name: vitals
description: Everything about the session Claude Code does not show on its own, in one row above the prompt: prompt cache warm or cold, what the next message costs, the account and its usage limits with resets, the context and when to compact. A pane with Now, Context, Cost, Timeline and Settings; a terminal status line with the fields you choose; $.vitals for other plugins. Works in the terminal and the desktop app. By Eryk Sadowski.

ttl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto: 1h on a Claude subscription, 5m on an API key. Set it by hand if you changed promptCacheTtl.

guard.title: Cold send guard
guard.description: Default for every repo. off: nothing. confirm: hold a message sent into a cold cache once and show the price, the resend goes through. warn: only show the price. A repo can keep its own (/vitals guard repo on|off), a session too (/vitals guard, or the pane).

keepWarm.title: Keep Warm at start
keepWarm.description: Default for every repo. off: no pings. on: every new session starts with Keep Warm on. A repo can keep its own (/vitals warm repo on|off), a session too (/vitals warm, or the pane).

keepWarmFor.title: Keep Warm for
keepWarmFor.description: How long after your last message Keep Warm goes on pinging. Each ping costs one cache read of the context.

bandFields.title: Band fields
bandFields.description: Fields of the one row above the prompt, in order, comma separated. Empty: cache, next, account, 5h, 7d, spend, context, compact. All: account, email, model, effort, mode, style, dir, branch, cache, next, ifcold, context, compact, hit, 5h, 7d, spend, session. /vitals band ... changes it per account.
bandFields.default: cache, next, account, 5h, 7d, spend, context, compact

lineFields.title: Status line fields
lineFields.description: Fields of the terminal status line, in order, comma separated (same names as the band). Empty: account, model, effort, cache, next, 5h, 7d, context, compact, branch. /vitals line ... changes it per account.
lineFields.default: account, model, effort, cache, next, 5h, 7d, context, compact, branch

statusLine.title: Status line under the prompt
statusLine.description: auto: the terminal's statusLine script prints it; the band above the prompt covers the desktop app, so nothing is pinned twice. on: also pinned under the prompt (the desktop app too). off: nowhere. /vitals line on|off|auto per account.

resetStyle.title: Limit reset as
resetStyle.description: auto and countdown: 6d 15h, then 14h 20m within a day. clock: 14:40, or Sun 05:00 further off. both.

accountLabels.title: Account labels
accountLabels.description: Your own name per config folder, e.g. '.claude=A, .claude-b=Work, .claude-c=3'. Empty: a letter from the folder (.claude is A, .claude-b is B).

alfred.title: Send usage to Alfred
alfred.description: on: at most once a minute per session, send the usage limits, context and model id (never the e-mail) to the local Alfred engine, for its account and context pills.

alfredHome.title: Alfred folder
alfredHome.description: Where alfred-app lives; its data/api.token is the local token.

compactHint.title: Compact hint
compactHint.description: on: the band says when compacting is worth it (the cache is cold and the context large, or auto-compact is near) and the pane's Context tab offers Compact Now. off: no hint.

compactAt.title: Compact hint from
compactAt.description: With a cold cache, the context share of the window from which the hint shows. Near auto-compact it shows anyway.
